info.title: API.SH: Google Trends
info.description: The Google Trends API from API.SH: public Google Trends data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.description:
The topics (with their mids and types) Trends suggests for a term.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-trends-autocomplete

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The full Google Trends category tree (names and ids to pass as category to the other Trends routes), or, with q, the categories whose name matches with their path and depth.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-trends-categories

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Interest over time, interest by region, related queries and related topics for up to 5 terms in one call, as the Trends explore page shows them (values are 0-100 relative).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-trends-interest

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: Country (US) or region (US-CA) code; omit for worldwide.

parameters.name: time
parameters.description: now 1-H, now 4-H, now 1-d, now 7-d, today 1-m, today 3-m, today 12-m (default), today 5-y, all, or "YYYY-MM-DD YYYY-MM-DD".

parameters.name: resolution
parameters.description: Region breakdown: country, region (default), city, dma.

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Comma-separated subset of time, region, queries, topics (default all four).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Related searches from Google Trends for up to 5 terms: the top and the rising related queries for each term, each with its value (relative interest from 0 to 100 for top queries; growth in % for rising ones, `Breakout` above +5000%) and a Trends link. Filter by region, period, category and search property (web, images, news, YouTube, shopping). A `note` says when Trends has too little data to list any.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-trends-related

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search term, or up to 5 comma-separated terms.

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: Country code (`US`) or region (`US-CA`); leave out for worldwide.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The full Trending Now table of a country or region (hundreds of rows, where /google-trends/v1/trending is the short feed): query, search volume, increase %, start and end time, active or not, categories, and the related queries that make up each trend. Filter by `category` (id or name) and `active=1`. Order the list with sort: relevance (default), title, volume (search volume, highest first) or recency (newest first).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-trends-trending-now

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: Country or region code, default US (e.g. GB, US-CA).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id or name, e.g. 17 or Sports.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Google's Year in Search for a year and country (or global): the #1 trending term per category and every top-10 list (searches, people, news, passings, actors, movies, TV shows, athletes, musicians, songs, recipes, games, how-to and what-is questions, Maps and Lens lists and more, as published).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/google-trends-year-in-search

parameters.name: geo
parameters.description: Country code such as US, GB, IN, or global (default).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
